nary_nodes.label: Trump threatens Iranian infrastructure
evidence: US President Donald Trump warned on Wednesday that the US would destroy one bridge or power plant each time Iran fired at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

From this point forward, any time the Islamic Republic of Iran shoots at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz, whether it be by missile, rocket, drone, or any other device or weapon, the United States will bomb and destroy ONE BRIDGE OR POWER PLANT.

nary_nodes.label: Araghchi adopts eye-for-an-eye doctrine
evidence: Seyed Abbas Araghchi, Iran's foreign minister, said his country would adopt an 'eye for an eye' defence doctrine.
'Any aggression against Iran, including our infrastructure, will compel a powerful and decisive response,' he posted on Wednesday on X.

nary_nodes.label: US 11th night of strikes on Iran
evidence: The US carried out another wave of strikes on Iran overnight into Wednesday, and air defences opened fire over the capital, Tehran.
The US military said earlier on Wednesday that it had completed an 11th night of strikes on Iran, with targets including aircraft hangars and drone storage sites.

nary_nodes.label: Iran attacks Jordanian city
evidence: Iran launched a missile attack on a Jordanian city on Israel's doorstep, and alerts were issued in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia.
Jordan's military said it intercepted four Iranian missiles over Aqaba, while two others fell in 'uninhabited areas'.

nary_nodes.label: Strait of Hormuz closure
evidence: Both sides have dug in over the strait, a crucial waterway for global energy that remains largely closed because of Iranian attacks.
The closure of the strait, through which a fifth of the world's traded oil and gas passed during peacetime, has jolted the global economy.

nary_nodes.label: Guterres condemns civilian infrastructure attacks
evidence: International law generally prohibits such attacks unless the infrastructure is being used for military purposes.
United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres decried such attacks as 'unacceptable' on Tuesday.

nary_nodes.label: Potential targeting of Pickaxe Mountain
evidence: He signalled that US forces could soon target an under-construction Iranian nuclear site buried deep beneath a mountain.
The site, known as Pickaxe Mountain, lies on the south side of Iran's Natanz nuclear enrichment site.

nary_nodes.label: US reimposes blockade on Iranian ports
evidence: In response to Iran's attacks, the US reimposed a blockade on Iranian ports.

nary_nodes.label: Brent crude oil price rise
evidence: Benchmark Brent crude oil rose to more than $93 a barrel in trading.
That's up from less than $72 early this month.

nary_nodes.label: US strikes kill 53 in Iran
evidence: Iran's Health Ministry says US strikes over the past 11 days have killed 53 people, including six women and three children, and wounded nearly 600 people.

nary_nodes.label: Rubio denounces Iran's strait actions
evidence: At a regional summit in the Philippines, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio denounced Iran's actions in the strait.

If we create a precedent in the Middle East where a nation state can decide that they are going to control an international waterway, charge a toll and if you don't pay them, blow up your ships, we have created a very dangerous precedent.

nary_nodes.label: Strait closure disrupts global economy
evidence: The closure of the strait... has jolted the global economy with effects far beyond the Middle East.

nary_nodes.label: Momeni visits Pakistan
evidence: Iran's Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni visited Pakistan, a key mediator in the conflict, seeking to revive diplomacy.

nary_nodes.label: Bahrain and Saudi Arabia issue alerts
evidence: Another missile alert sounded in Bahrain, and Saudi Arabia warned residents of the Gulf city of Dammam to seek shelter.

nary_nodes.label: Iran targets energy infrastructure
evidence: Iran has responded to US attacks by targeting energy infrastructure and desalination plants that provide drinking water in parched neighbouring Gulf countries.

nary_nodes.label: Iran strikes desalination plants
evidence: Iran has responded to US attacks by targeting energy infrastructure and desalination plants that provide drinking water in parched neighbouring Gulf countries.

nary_nodes.label: Escalating war with no off-ramp
evidence: Trump's latest threat to target civilian infrastructure came as the unpopular war spiralled with no clear off-ramp, threatening further global economic disruption.

nary_nodes.label: Fuel prices climb before US midterms
evidence: Petrol prices are also climbing.
Benchmark Brent crude oil rose to more than $93 a barrel in trading.
